title: Daily digest: Hyderabad CJP leads protest march from L | Farmers led by BRS leaders stage protest | Owaisi files PIL in Supreme Court challe
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Hyderabad CJP leads protest march from LB Stadium to Gun Park.
Farmers led by BRS leaders stage protest at canal regulator in Choppadandi.
Owaisi files PIL in Supreme Court challenging Election Commission’s nationwide SIR exercise.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad CJP leads ne Stadium se Gun Park ko march LB ke khilaf ehhtejaj kiya.
BRS rahnumaon ki qiyadat mein kisanon ka Choppadandi mein nahar regulator par ehtijaj
Owaisi ne Election Commission ki nationwide SIR exercise ke khilaf Supreme Court mein PIL daair kar di
